Get a work log, grouped by day. It covers today unless you choose a period.

## Input

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `yesterday` | `boolean` | no | Cover yesterday and today. |
| `week` | `boolean` | no | Cover the current week. |
| `month` | `boolean` | no | Cover the current month. |
| `from` | `string` | no | Start of the period (inclusive): a local day (YYYY-MM-DD) or an ISO timestamp. Overrides yesterday, week, and month. |
| `to` | `string` | no | End of the period (inclusive): a local day (YYYY-MM-DD) or an ISO timestamp. Overrides yesterday, week, and month. |
| `project` | `string` | no | Only entries of this project. |
| `repo` | `string` | no | Only entries of this repository (owner/name). |
| `tags` | `string[]` | no | Only entries that have all of these tags. |

## Output

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `title` | `string` | yes | Title of the period, for example Today (2026-11-15). |
| `start` | `string` | yes | Start of the period, as an ISO timestamp. |
| `end` | `string` | yes | End of the period, as an ISO timestamp. |
| `days` | `object[]` | yes | The days of the period, oldest first. |
| `days.date` | `string` | yes | Local day, as YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `days.entries` | `object[]` | yes | Entries of this day, oldest first. |
| `days.entries.id` | `string` | yes | Unique id of the entry. The last 8 characters work as a short id. |
| `days.entries.createdAt` | `string` | yes | When the entry was created, as an ISO timestamp. |
| `days.entries.updatedAt` | `string` | yes | When the entry last changed, as an ISO timestamp. |
| `days.entries.deletedAt` | `string \| null` | yes | When the entry was deleted, or null if it is not deleted. |
| `days.entries.deviceId` | `string` | yes | Id of the device that created the entry. |
| `days.entries.summary` | `string` | yes | One line that says what happened. |
| `days.entries.details` | `string \| null` | yes | Longer text for the entry, or null. |
| `days.entries.kind` | `"done" \| "blocker" \| "next"` | yes | done, blocker (something stops you), or next (a planned step). |
| `days.entries.status` | `"open" \| "resolved" \| null` | yes | open or resolved for a blocker or next entry. Null for a done entry. |
| `days.entries.resolvedAt` | `string \| null` | yes | When the entry was resolved, or null. |
| `days.entries.resolvedByEntryId` | `string \| null` | yes | Id of the entry that resolved this one, or null. |
| `days.entries.project` | `string` | yes | Project name. |
| `days.entries.repo` | `string \| null` | yes | Repository (owner/name), or null. |
| `days.entries.branch` | `string \| null` | yes | Git branch, or null. |
| `days.entries.source` | `"cli" \| "mcp" \| "migration"` | yes | Where the entry came from: the CLI, the MCP server, or a migration. |
| `days.entries.agent` | `string \| null` | yes | Name of the agent that logged the entry, or null. |
| `days.entries.tags` | `string[]` | yes | Tags of the entry. |
| `days.entries.refs` | `object[]` | yes | References such as PRs and ticket keys. |
| `days.entries.refs.type` | `"pr" \| "jira" \| "commit" \| "url"` | yes | Kind of reference. |
| `days.entries.refs.value` | `string` | yes | The PR number, ticket key, commit hash, or URL. |
| `days.entries.refs.repo` | `string` | no | Repository (owner/name) of the reference. |
| `count` | `number` | yes | Number of entries in the period. |
| `projectCount` | `number` | yes | Number of projects that have entries in the period. |
| `linkedActivity` | `object` | yes | GitHub activity that gournal linked to an entry. The key is the entry id. |
| `linkedActivity.<key>` | `object[]` | yes | Activity items linked to this entry. |
| `linkedActivity.<key>.id` | `string` | yes | Unique id of the activity item. |
| `linkedActivity.<key>.createdAt` | `string` | yes | When gournal stored the item, as an ISO timestamp. |
| `linkedActivity.<key>.updatedAt` | `string` | yes | When the item last changed, as an ISO timestamp. |
| `linkedActivity.<key>.deletedAt` | `string \| null` | yes | When the item was deleted, or null. |
| `linkedActivity.<key>.deviceId` | `string` | yes | Id of the device that stored the item. |
| `linkedActivity.<key>.type` | `"commit" \| "pr_opened" \| "pr_merged" \| "review"` | yes | Kind of activity: a commit, an opened PR, a merged PR, or a review. |
| `linkedActivity.<key>.occurredAt` | `string` | yes | When the activity happened on GitHub, as an ISO timestamp. |
| `linkedActivity.<key>.repo` | `string` | yes | Repository (owner/name). |
| `linkedActivity.<key>.branch` | `string \| null` | yes | Git branch of the PR, or null. |
| `linkedActivity.<key>.externalId` | `string` | yes | Id of the item on GitHub: the PR number, commit hash, or review id. |
| `linkedActivity.<key>.title` | `string \| null` | yes | PR title or first line of the commit message, or null. |
| `linkedActivity.<key>.url` | `string \| null` | yes | GitHub URL of the item, or null. |
| `linkedActivity.<key>.capturedBy` | `"github"` | yes | Where the item came from. Always github. |
| `linkedActivity.<key>.pr` | `number \| null` | yes | PR number that the item belongs to, or null. |
| `linkedActivity.<key>.payload` | `object` | yes | Extra data from GitHub, for example the review state. |
| `syncWarning` | `string \| null` | yes | A warning from the automatic GitHub sync, or null. The same warning is the last line of the text result. |
